evals.prompt: Run a full daily server audit. I need to see active users, their resource usage, whether I should be courteous, and any stale files or Docker images to clean up.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown report showing: (1) active users and their CPU/memory usage, (2) courtesy status (is Bryan, Peter, or Kirk active?), (3) resource cap reminder (60% max), (4) list of stale files with ages and sizes, (5) unused Docker images with owner and creation date.

evals.prompt: Run a quick hourly check to see who's currently on the server and what resources they're using. Keep it brief.
evals.expected_output: A short report showing: (1) active users, (2) their CPU threads, memory, and CPU usage, (3) overall server status (CPU, memory, disk %), (4) resource cap reminder. No stale files or Docker info.

evals.prompt: Generate a cleanup report focused on stale files and unused Docker images. What should be deleted?
evals.expected_output: A Markdown report with two sections: (1) Stale Files (files older than 30 days, with size and age), (2) Docker Images (unused 12+ months, with owner and creation date). Include recommendations (DELETE, REVIEW, etc.).
